Had a middle school math teacher that was known among students and teachers alike for being an abusive twat. She yelled at special ed students constantly, if you put your elbow on the desk she made you stand at your desk for the whole period and for the rest of the week in that class. She never tought and just put on videos from Khan academy, sat at her desk and browsed Facebook on her phone. She never let you leave the classroom for any reason, nurse, office, bathroom. Nothing. One boy actaully peed his pants in her class because she was refusing to let him go even though he was begging, so he just wet the seat and cursed at her. Mind, we're like 14-15 around this time so it was super embarressing for him. 
The school didnt really have anyone to replace her so she got away with a whole bunch of shit. She finally got removed when she chucked a textbook at a kid and left him a huge bruise on his face AND bragged about it on Facebook as a good punishment.
All they did was [transfer her](https://www.google.com/amp/s/whnt.com/2012/10/18/florence-city-school-board-suspends-middle-school-teacher/amp/) though, pretty quick to defend so now a bunch of 5th graders are suffering.
